translations.text: You love him whom you have not seen, and through faith in him you rejoice with glorious joy that cannot be expressed.
Let your souls be holy through obedience to the truth, and let them be filled with love that shows no partiality, so that you love one another from a pure and perfect heart.
Be like newborn infants, and long for the word as for pure, spiritual milk, so that through it you may grow into life.
You too, like living stones, be built up and become spiritual temples and holy priests, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable before God through Jesus Christ.
As free people, not as people who make their freedom a cover for their wickedness, but as servants of God.
When he was insulted, he did not insult in return, and when he suffered, he did not threaten. Instead, he entrusted his case to the righteous judge.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears listen to them, but the face of the Lord is against the wicked.
If, then, Christ suffered for you in the flesh, arm yourselves with this same way of thinking. For everyone who dies in his body has ceased from all sins.
Be alert and be mindful, because your enemy Satan roars and prowls like a lion, seeking someone to devour.
